title: MyEnsContacts
tagline: A simple ENS domains contacts list / phone book type app to store and show your ens contacts profiles.
description:
This app is a contact list for your ENS contacts. It pulls ENS profile data using either an address or an ENS domain. You can add or delete contacts. Expanding a profile you can copy information to clipboard by clicking or view an address QR code.
This version uses the browser localstorage to store the contact list.
how_its_made: The app is made using NextJS with Tailwind for css and uses the official @ensdomains/ensjs package to pull ENS profile information. We had planned  to use Tableland to store the contact list but ran out of time. There are many more options for adding / using sponsor products like covalent to show the transfers between the user and a contact as an example.
